notes.title: Water Tanks, Crafting Timer and more....
notes.content: [p]Welcome back survivors! New additions and fixes that have been made in this newest version.[/p][list][*][p]Added a placeable water tank that allows storing 100 cans of water[/p][/*][*][p]Added a crafting timer that speeds up time when you craft items[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sound when passing an item into a container or chest[/p][/*][*][p]Added different crafting sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added an auto zoom option that when enabled automatically zooms out when aiming (default = on)[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-mining now speeds up time[/p][/*][*][p]Increased tool tip font size[/p][/*][*][p]Updated fishing to now speed up time and slightly increased the chance to get a fish instead of plant fibers[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the arrow recipe to use flint instead of stone[/p][/*][*][p]Updated shelter collision to be able to see under it when the player is a little further away[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the chance for animals to be sleeping[/p][/*][*][p]Preformance improvements[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Still adjusting and adding..
notes.content: [p]Thank you for reading.  We have been calmy adding small changes and effects.  Here are the improvements/fixes for the update.[/p][list][*][p]Added text to each placeable bench to explain what should be put into it.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a craftable fire pit.  Cooks food and water faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a bench opening effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a player pickup and put down effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Added lakes to maps instead of the water icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a smoke effect on campfires.[/p][/*][*][p]Added leaves flowing in the wind effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to hold items in your had a place 1 or all into chests and some benches.[/p][/*][*][p]Added plant fiber drops when cutting down a tree.[/p][/*][*][p]Added animal eating animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the bear and boar AI.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated compost bin crafting recipe to require worms.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated compost bin have a chance to drop worms along with soil drops.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated rotten food to drop in the left corner for all placeable benches.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the ability to access inventory when sleeping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where fish nets were not showing empty right after being emptied.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Minor Fixes
notes.content: [p]A small patch to update a few bugs and tweaks.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Small Green Rug was not able to be placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where animals were not reacting to being hit by arrows while walking.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some animals were not fleeing from gunfire.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where steam screenshots where not able to be taken.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lighting issues when in shelters and cabins.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the main menu music stopping after a long period of time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where offscreen animals were leaving excessive blood trails.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered health increase when sleeping.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the shelter placing collisions to allow them to be placed over other items.  This gives players additional freedom when placing rain covers.[/p][/*][*][p]Spelling fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.content:
We have updated our demo to get it ready for the Steam Next Fest starting February 24th.  Here are all the amazing things we have added:

[list]
[*] Time passes when sleeping
[*] Food now expires into rotten food
[*] Doubled a day's length
[*] Limited stack sizes for most items
[*] Nights are now very dark
[*] Added a craftable headlamp
[*] Added craftable torches that use charcoal as fuel
[*] Can now craft and place doors
[*] Added 4 additional hotbar options (total of 8)
[*] Traps now allow all vegan items (for rabbits) and meat items (for boars)
[*] Improved animal AI
[*] Animals now sleep at night
[*] Increased animal size and they can spawn in different sizes now
[*] Added a furniture bench which allows crafting furniture items and walls
[*] Added a compost bin that will create soil when perishable items are added to it
[*] Added a drying rack that allows for drying food items and turns animal fur into leather over time
[*] Add a chopping block that allows crafting firewood and wooden planks
[*] Added a craftable water collector that collects water when it rains
[*] Updated placeable items to only be destroyed if the player has bare hands and punches the item
[*] Added berry bushes
[*] Changed shovel tools to only allow placing a farm plot if you have soil
[*] Updated the ammo bench recipe to require leather so that players cannot have guns as early in the game
[*] The player and animals now takes damage from stepping in a fire
[*] Can now catch both perch and salmon fish
[*] The player must now find fish in the lake in order to fish
[*] Added a craftable rake that allows for placing paths
[*] Shelters now keep you warm
[*] Added RNG chests
[*] Added a control task for easy access of the current mapped controls
[*] Added leaves falling when breaking plants and trees
[*] Added a craftable watering can for farm plots
[*] Added multiple new messages (bottom right) that appear when doing things in the game
[*] Food plants now always drop a seed
[/list]
